description: Ministry of Labour, Trade Union Relations - Award made for the Industrial Dispute between A. P. K. Weeraratne and National Water Supply & Drainage Board, E. Hettiarachchi with two others and Sri Lanka Transport Board (E only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of an arbitration award related to an industrial dispute under the Industrial Disputes Act. It involves legal proceedings, statutory interpretation, and references to specific sections of labor legislation. The content focuses on regulatory compliance, legal procedures, and the application of labor laws rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories. This fits squarely within Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it deals with the implementation and interpretation of existing laws and regulations.
